thread:
Maya Patel: Quick handoff thread for Gaia-Large-v2 marketplace & HW partner delivery. Need clear owner for: license wording, artifact packaging, and partner download flow. Launch target 2024-06-12.
Carlos Ruiz: I'll own marketplace gating. First question: can we upload a manifest-only package + small stub and host large kernel bundles behind authenticated partner links? Some marketplaces dislike >10GB uploads.
Jen Park: EdgeWave prefers smaller marketplace payloads. They require kernel hashes + signed manifest and will pull optimizations from a partner URL. They cannot accept raw fp16 checkpoints on their appliances.
Omar Khan: Runtime sides: we will produce q4_8 and q4_0 builds and a runtime shim. We can include a flag to disable telemetry and produce a signed no-telemetry manifest. Will add automated signature.
Sasha (Legal): License principle: partners may distribute integrated, quantized runtime artifacts only. Redistribution of raw checkpoints prohibited unless explicit exception approved. I'll prepare a short addendum for the marketplace seller form and an exception workflow.
Priya Nair: On co-marketing: EdgeWave needs logo approval and a PR blurb signed off by legal. Also confirm embargo window. Marketing deadline is 2024-06-05.
Carlos Ruiz: Action items: I'll map per-marketplace upload limits and EULA fields and report by 2024-05-22.
Jen Park: Deliverable: EdgeWave hardware spec + manifest schema (kernels[], hw_compat matrix) by 2024-05-18.
Omar Khan: I'll stage two artifacts: gaia-q4_8-no-telemetry.tar.gz (marketplace) and gaia-q4_8-dev.tar.gz (SI sandbox with telemetry). Will post build links when ready.
Sasha (Legal): Draft addendum will include telemetry clause: "Partner must not re-enable telemetry or alter provenance without Redwood written consent." Also include export-control checklist.
deploy-bot: created artifact pipeline: gaia-q4-no-telemetry-20240518 queued.
Maya Patel: Consolidating: Sasha = legal addendum (due 05-20), Carlos = marketplace mapping (05-22), Jen = EdgeWave spec (05-18), Omar = artifact builds (05-24), Priya = PR coordination (05-25). Follow-up sync 05-23.
Maya Patel: Thanks team — keeping this thread as the single source of truth for the partner launch.
